NOVELTY STATEMENT (INTERVENTION)
To prevent moisture-induced degradation of the ethylene-vinyl alcohol (EVOH) barrier layer in multilayer food packaging films, we propose inserting a hydrophilic silica interlayer between the EVOH and adjacent polyolefin layers. Standard practice relies solely on the inherent hydrophobicity of polyolefins to shield EVOH; our mitigation introduces a sacrificial moisture sink that physically blocks humidity from reaching the EVOH before it can plasticize the matrix. The closest existing technique is nanoclay barrier enhancement in packaging films, but our approach differs by using silica's hygroscopicity as an active moisture scavenger rather than as a physical maze. This arrangement attacks the failure's driving physics—moisture plasticization—by intercepting and binding water molecules at the interface where humidity ingress begins.

PHYSICS CHECK
The governing relation is Fick's first law of diffusion: J = -D·(Δc/Δx), where J is the flux, D is diffusivity, and Δc/Δx is the concentration gradient. The silica interlayer reduces Δc at the EVOH interface by adsorbing water, lowering the effective moisture concentration gradient driving diffusion into EVOH. Silica's hygroscopic capacity (≈1 g H₂O/g silica at 65% RH) provides a stoichiometric sink; a 1 μm silica layer can bind ~0.5 g/m² of moisture, reducing Δc by >90% based on silica's 100× higher affinity for water vs. EVOH.

IMPLEMENTATION BILL
- (b) Commercial hydrophilic silica coating (3 μm thickness, standard aqueous dispersion, 30 wt% solids, applied via gravure coater)
- (c) Adjust coater speed to 15 m/min (standard operation at reduced line speed)
- (c) Cure silica layer at 80°C for 10 sec (standard thermal cure per supplier spec)
- (a) Existing EVOH extrusion line (no change)
- (a) Existing polyolefin lamination process (no change)

BURDEN LEDGER (STANDARD-PRACTICE PARITY)
| Standard Practice Row          | Our Intervention Row          | Burden Change |
|--------------------------------|------------------------------|---------------|
| EVOH extrusion (existing)      | EVOH extrusion (existing)    | Same          |
| Polyolefin lamination (existing)| Polyolefin lamination (existing)| Same      |
| Single coater pass (existing)  | Single coater pass + silica  | +1 coater pass (same class)|
| Cure at 90°C for 15 sec (existing)| Cure at 80°C for 10 sec (existing)| Same operation |
| Line speed: 20 m/min (existing)| Line speed: 15 m/min (existing)| Same class    |
| **Total Burden**               |                              | **Same class**|

EXECUTABLE TEST
**Protocol:** Accelerated aging test per ASTM E96 (modified for multilayer films). Cut 100×100 mm samples (n=10 per group) and condition at 25°C/65% RH. Measure water vapor transmission rate (WVTR) weekly via gravimetric method (ASTM E96).  
**Instruments:** Analytical balance (±0.1 mg), humidity chamber (±1°C/±2% RH), desiccators.  
**Pass/Fail:** Intervention group maintains WVTR ≤0.5 g/m²/day at all time points; control group exceeds 0.5 g/m²/day by month 6.  
**Duration:** 18 months (or 6 months at 40°C/75% RH for accelerated equivalence).  
**Kill Criterion:** Any sample in intervention group exceeding 0.5 g/m²/day at any test point fails the mechanism.

- Maintenance: No additional steps (same cleaning/inspection schedule).
